description.text: Course For students having Certificate for Intermediate Chinese Training. For students who have mastered about 3800 words. Advanced Courses Course Name Class Hours/Week CompulsoryAdvanced Chinese 8 Advanced Reading 4 Advanced Listening 2 Advanced Spoken Chinese 2 Chinese Culture(II) 2 Chinese Writing 2 SelectiveCalligraphy 2 Martial Arts 2 HSK 2 Audio – Visual Course 2 Chinese Go 2 Business Writing Translation

duration.text: The Advanced Chinese Training Course at Henan University of Technology is a 1 Month long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 805 USD/In total ￥ 5800 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: The applicant should meet the following conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in the age bracket of 18-50 with good health Holding the Elementary Program graduation diploma
